about: Strings for Silent Night's Kiểu 2 (version 1), written by Composer's Assistant 2 hearing the Rhodes (its tune, rolling chords and deep bass), laid out as Jingle Bells' Kiểu 2 strings were in 2a, the version the user chose there: a bed from the first verse to the last chord (bars 4-52, two verses after the 4-bar intro), the violas (two notes at a time at most) and the cellos (one) throughout, the violins (one) in the last verse, each under the tune (loosely: lay_in keeps what the model wrote); notes starting about twice a bar (horiz 1), the cellos less (horiz 0), the upper strings mostly by step (step 4).
